mentions.name: Orris Breathing
mentions.description: An iOS box breathing app built with SwiftUI that guides breathing exercises with color-coded breathing phases, customizable timing, and session tracking; currently in TestFlight beta.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a box breathing app for iOS. Started it to manage stress and as an excuse to get back into native development. SwiftUI with color-coded breathing phases, customizable timing, and session tracking. In TestFlight now with beta testers.
